1. In relation to a literary work in a non-dramatic form: it means a version of the work in a dramatic form, whether in its original language or another language.

2. In relation to a literary work in a dramatic form: it means a version of the work in a non-dramatic form, again whether in its original language or another language.

3. In relation to a computer program (literary work): it refers to a version of the work, regardless of whether it's in the same language, code, or format.

The context also provides an additional clarification regarding adaptations of computer programs and when making reproductions or adaptations might be permissible under certain conditions related to error correction.
